name: nhtsa-pe-recall
description: Will a newly opened NHTSA preliminary evaluation (PE) into a vehicle defect result in a linked safety recall campaign within 24 months?
split_description: Chronological by ODATE: train 1995-01-01 to 2007-12-31; eval 2008-01-01 to 2014-12-31; holdout 2015-01-01 to 2019-12-31. No embargo; each row is a distinct PE and no feature uses another row's outcome. All 24-month label windows close by 2021-12-31, before the 2026 snapshot.
